name: QGF1
scope: os30 private native experiment; reuse BIM2 snapshots; TFP1 disabled; ordinary GPU semantics retained

metadata.0x01b: importable slots: successful LOAD, clip zero, positive normal W<32767
metadata.0x01c..0x01f: four W fingerprint bitplanes: XOR all eight nibbles of exact W bits; bits indexed raw local slot

gpu_run_payload: first_global[4:0], cull_mode[6:5], reserved7=0, alpha[15:8], triangle_count[22:16] 1..64, reserved31:23=0
triangle_count words: raw-local indices [4:0],[9:5],[14:10], others zero
gpu_release_opcode: 0x61, payload one word BIM2 token; release ordered at producer generation end, after last run; run itself drops read ownership but retains bank
admission: RNE, supported opaque material, current successful raw generation, every index importable, every triangle has W fingerprints not all equal. No clipping/equal-W fallback can remain; only cull arithmetic repair.

repair.0x020: read: busy bit0, pending bit1, sticky protocol error bit2
repair.0x021: read repair serial token, distinct from snapshot generation; increment per repair
repair.0x023: read cull mode low2, job index bits[13:8]
repair.0x025: read synchronous operand: vertex0 X,Y,invW, then vertex1, then vertex2; index write precedes data read
repair.0x02e: write repair serial token to acknowledge
repair.0x02d: write bit0 valid, bit1 keep; accepted only pending with matching token and full strobe

ordering: Preflight every triangle before any output; repair unsupported arithmetic using immutable snapshot exact CPU nine-op sequence; retain keep mask; emit ordinary 0x56 loads then 0x54 draws into independent 512-word FIFO. CPU can continue enqueueing state/runs while worker processes. Reuse ingress ring for job RAM.
snapshot_lifetime: CLAIM once per generation reused by multiple runs; explicit 0x61 ends lifetime after all payload values copied into output FIFO. CPU emits release before replacing raw generation or frame end. Fallback legacy BIM2 importer disabled on QGF-capable core.
reset: GPU reset cancels queued work and snapshots but cannot abandon accepted raw DMA. Shared FMA owner drains any in-flight operation before granting raw LOAD after consumer reset.

ports.math_grant: wrapper->GPU ownership; remains asserted until math_release
ports.math_release: GPU->wrapper one-cycle pulse after final cull result, no requests outstanding

worker_reset_contract: math_release asserted/drained safely on consumer reset by wrapper (track outstanding FMA latency); worker receives GPU reset; wrapper must never use GPU reset for raw DMA reset
